newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian shrs driven up by manufacturing, banking.
newsitem.headline: Colombian shrs driven up by manufacturing, banking.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged up Thursday driven by manufacturing and banking.
Bogota's IBB .IBB index closed up 0.44 percent to 1,199 amid a 3.3 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED .IBMG ended up 0.39 percent at 18,232.77 amid a 3.26 billion peso volume.

"Trading volumes were fairly normal but there was heavy demand from foreign funds and local investors for blue chips because of generally low prices and the scant opportunities offered in the fixed term securities market," one Medellin trader said.
